text: 中国10年期国债“26附息国债16”收益率下行0.95bp报1.5790%，续创历史新低。 30年期国债“26超长特别国债04”收益率下行1.45bp报2.0360%。 国债期货30年期主力合约一度上涨0.35%。
text_en: The yield on China's 10-year government bond "26 Interest-Bearing Government Bond 16" fell 0.95 bp to 1.5790%, continuing to hit a record low. The yield on the 30-year government bond "26 Ultra-Long Special Government Bond 04" fell 1.45 bp to 2.0360%. The 30-year main contract of government bond futures rose 0.35% at one point.
